description:
15Five is the AI-powered performance management platform built for business impact. 15Five’s AI-powered all-in-one people management system is easy to use, delivers effortless insights, and enables managers to lead with impact so that companies and their people can thrive. Within the flow of work, HR leaders are empowered with data-driven insights and recommendations while managers are transformed into change-makers, accelerating engagement, performance, and retention. 15Five combines generative AI, custom analytics, and human-centered principles within a complete platform, including 360° performance reviews, engagement surveys, goal tracking, manager coaching and training, and ongoing feedback tools like guided 1-on-1s and check-ins.
 
 
A career at 15Five is the chance to have high impact in a fast paced, remote startup environment that operates with focus, urgency, and accountability. Every role and every hire meaningfully impacts our trajectory.
 
We’re a high-performance, high-purpose team that gives you the chance to Build the Future of Work. We run on High Standards and High Support — holding a high bar for results, ownership, clarity, and disciplined execution, while investing in manager enablement, skill development, and whole-person care. We are committed to a No B.S. environment, meaning we anchor ourselves in truth, course-correct in real time, and expect people to lean into direct conversations. We are focused on ensuring every 15Fiver can Work in the Future and that starts with proactively using AI across all aspects of your role to increase leverage, speed, and impact.
 
If you're energized by a fast pace, high standards, and high accountability for yourself and others, you'll thrive here and we encourage you to apply.

At 15five, our AI agents work alongside HR teams to run reviews and calibrations, prepare managers for 1-on-1s, coach in the moment, and answer questions about their people. They draw on a context layer that connects 15Five's people data (e.g. reviews, goals, engagement, and HRIS) with the tools where work happens, such as meetings, chat, and CRM. Through MCP, the same intelligence is available inside the AI assistants people already use. The result: HR leaders and managers spend less time on administration and more time improving performance, engagement, and retention.

As our Senior AI Platform Engineer, you will build the AI-native tools, processes, and standards that the rest of 15Five runs on. You will own how we provision customers, how we test against realistic data without exposing it, how agents help us respond to incidents, and how every team writes, evaluates, and governs the prompts and agents that power our product.
 
 
Reports To: Chief Technology Officer

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own management tools for customer provisioning and administration, so that partners such as PEOs can create, configure, and manage many customer tenants in the 15Five platform, and so our own teams can do the same.

  • Own our staging and sandbox environments, including synthetic datasets that exercise every capability of the platform without exposing customer PII.

  • Design and run an AI-native, agentic on-call process: agents that react to errors and incidents and trigger workflows for diagnosis, planning, and resolution, with engineers reviewing and approving at the right points.

  • Orchestrate AI and data governance across the company, including the controls, audit trails, and processes that support compliance programs such as HIPAA.

  • Create and run the company standard for prompt engineering, using in-house and third-party tools for prompt testing, version control, evaluations, and cost management.

  • Build, orchestrate, and deploy agents and multi-step workflows across our systems, and decide when to build in-house and when to adopt a third-party tool.

  • Work across our stack: Python and Django on the backend, running on AWS, alongside our data platform (Snowflake, Airflow, DBT).

  • Work AI-native by default: use AI coding assistants and agents to move fast, while staying accountable for code that is correct, secure, and performant.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Security, Support, and Customer Success, and teach other engineers the practices and paved paths you put in place.

  • Review code and architecture designs, and write the documentation that makes your standards easy to follow.

  • Bring your Product mindset: treat engineers, customer facing teams, and partners as your customers, and contribute to the team's vision, goals, and roadmap.

    • SKILLS/COMPETENCIES

  • 5+ years of software development, with strong backend experience in Python. Experience with Django is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered features and agents in production: agent orchestration, tool calling (including MCP), retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily, fluent use of AI-native development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, and a clear point of view on how teams should use them.

  • Experience building internal platforms or developer tooling on AWS: environments, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and admin tools.

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, including tenant provisioning, configuration, and access management.

  • Working knowledge of data privacy and security practices: PII handling, data masking or synthetic data, access controls, and audit logging. Experience supporting HIPAA, SOC 2, or GDPR programs is a plus.

  • Experience with observability and incident response (for example Datadog), and with taking part in on-call.

  • Experience with prompt and model evaluation, prompt versioning, and tracking LLM usage and cost.

  • A track record of setting engineering standards that other teams adopt, through guidelines, tooling, and buy-in rather than mandates.

  • Experience working remotely and communicating clearly with engineering, product, security, and customer-facing teams.

    • WORKING AT 15FIVE

  • 15Five has a culture of high standards combined with high care. We hold a high bar for results, ownership, clarity, and disciplined execution, while investing in manager enablement, skill development, and whole-person care.

  • Our software engineers work in a highly collaborative environment that prioritizes communication, trust, and delivering the highest value to our customers.

  • We support the work of our peers by pair programming, reviewing, and providing mentorship.

  • We are accountable for our work, and follow through on our commitments, and expect the same of others.

  • We communicate in a respectful manner, assume positive intent, and own our impact on others.

  • The team values continuous, direct and actionable feedback.

  • The core processes are collaborative, their ownership is shared between all members of the team, and we look forward to new recommendations for process improvements.

  • We are comfortable collaborating across teams and orgs, in a remote work environment.

  • We encourage asking questions, and raising a hand when something doesn't seem quite right.

  • If you're energized by a fast pace, high standards, and high accountability for yourself and others, you'll thrive here and we encourage you to apply.

    • This is a full-time, salaried exempt position. The typical work week will be Monday through Friday, between the hours of 9:00 am and 6:00 pm (flexible), working an expected 40+ hours/week. Ability to accommodate early-morning or after-hours meetings at least 4 days a week is a must due to collaboration across various US/EU time zones.

    Reading over the role description and feeling like you don’t check every box? That’s okay; if you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily meet all the criteria, please apply—you could be exactly who we are looking for!
     
    15Five follows equitable hiring practices. Our compensation programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain talented employees who are highly engaged, high performing, and have an exceptional impact on the business and our customers.
     
    The salary range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hire salaries for the role across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by budget allocated for the role and additional factors, including job-related competencies and skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US job postings do not reflect added total compensation including equity or benefits.
     
    In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
